answer: At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a fable tag. The quill cap is checked at intake and lantern shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, since every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 23 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
